design: Fresh random dictionary, coordinate encoder, membership and energy detector. Joint label-free only. Add active-support coordinate costs0.005/0.02/0.05 to groupcost0.01; same initializations/batches as H700 joint baselines. For unknown gates train exact Bernoulli expected cost over16patterns; unknown membership uses hardTop3 ST. Same three seeds/minibatches. Select hard validation reconstruction+count cost every100steps, held combinations afterward. Joint condition never uses generating labels in optimization/selection.
limitations: One noiseless teacher,known latent/group sizes and3members pergroup,small exactenumeration,hardmembership surrogate. Different cost arms are tradeoffs, not selected on heldout. Counts charge active support; with continuous coordinates nonzero almost surely this equals codeL0 except exact zeros. Fixed membership costs constant; no learned membershipbudget.
